integrity.limit: Checks record integrity, not correctness of the plan or quality of the application.

observations.coverage: Supported local tool events only. Hosted web tools and model reasoning are not recorded. Raw prompts, commands and outputs are not copied; transcript references identify original detail.
observations.activation: Configured is not active. Codex requires project/hook trust. A non-synthetic event is evidence of delivery at that time, not a permanent guarantee.
observations.semantic_updates: The agent must record meaningful decisions, feedback and task changes using put/event. Hooks cannot infer their meaning.

limits: No paid model or application generation was run.
Synthetic hook calls prove handler behavior, not live Codex dispatch.
No claim that resumes are improved or that Lohith accepted this checkpoint.
